firstrun.welcome:
Welcome to DiBeKho!
The app will create a workspace folder for delivery notes, goods receipt files, backups and data. You can change it later in Settings.
firstrun.folder_hint: Avoid folders inside OneDrive, iCloud or Google Drive.

stock.hint: Stock is computed from stock counts, goods in and delivery notes. Double-click a row for its history.

pending.hint: Things the app needs you to decide. Empty means every note has been read. Fully recorded delivery notes are moved to phieu-giao-hang/da-xu-ly; notes still outside it are not done yet. input/da-xu-ly holds processed goods-in files and data packages.
pending.unknown_title: Product names not in the catalog

Pick one under 'Is product' (type a few letters, Vietnamese or Chinese, to search), or press '✕ Drop line' for lines that are not goods, such as shipping or service fees. The app remembers your choice.

{mapped} lines matched, {created} products created, {skipped} non-goods lines dropped.

file.changed_detail: {detail}. Stock is unchanged until you choose.
file.missing_detail: Order {code} is kept, stock unchanged. The app still has a copy of the file.
inbox.receipt_preview: Goods arrived on {date}. Check before confirming:
inbox.confirm_discard:

doc.hint_open_product: Double-click a line to open the product.
doc.original_missing: The copy of the original file is missing.
doc.confirm_cancel: Cancel this document? Stock will be reversed; history is kept.
customers.hint: Customers are taken from delivery notes automatically. Double-click to see what they buy.
search.hint: Search everything: products (Vietnamese/Chinese), customers, phone numbers, doc numbers, notes. Accents optional. Shortcut: Ctrl+F.
stats.hint: Pick a period and scope. Dates are the dates written on the documents. Double-click a row to open the product.
stats.caption: {period} · {products} products · in {qty_in} · out {qty_out}
stats.export_locked: Cannot write the file — a file with that name may be open in Excel.
receipts.steps:
How to record goods in:
1. Click 'Create goods-in template' → open it, fill the arrival date and quantities.
2. Save it, copy it into the input folder and go to 'To do' → 'Review & import';
   or click 'Choose a file to import…' and pick the file directly (from anywhere).
3. Check and confirm.
receipts.no_products: No products yet. Read some delivery notes or add products in Settings first.
count.hint: Count the goods and type the numbers in the yellow column. Only products with a count are recorded. The first count is the opening stock.
count.confirm: Save the count of {count} products on {date}? Stock will be adjusted to the counts.
transfer.steps:
Only one computer works at a time.
1. Current computer: click 'Export data' → a .dibekho file is created in the output folder.
2. Send that file to the other computer (USB, Zalo, email…).
3. Other computer: copy it into the input folder, go to 'To do' → 'Import data'. Its current data is backed up, then replaced.
transfer.has_changes: This computer has changes not exported yet.
transfer.confirm_import:
Import data from {device} (exported {at}: {deliveries} notes, {products} products)?

Current data on this computer will be backed up and then REPLACED.
transfer.unsent_warning:
⚠ This computer has changes that were not exported. Continuing replaces them (they stay in the backup).

Continue anyway?
transfer.import_failed:
Import failed; existing data was kept.

backup.title: Backups
backup.hint: The app backs up every day at start and before importing data; the newest 14 are kept.
backup.pick_first: Select a backup in the table first.
backup.confirm_restore: Restore '{name}'? Current data is backed up first, then replaced.
settings.restart_needed: Saved. Close and reopen the app to apply.
settings.products_hint: Select a row and press Edit product… (or double-click) to change the name, type/colour, group or low-stock level. Only a product that no document uses can be deleted; a used product can be marked inactive. Drag a column border to read long names.
settings.min_stock_hint: When stock is at or below this number, the product is highlighted yellow on the Stock screen as a reminder to reorder. Example: 10 means highlighted at 10 or less. 0 = no reminder.
settings.uninstall_title: Remove the app from this computer
settings.uninstall_hint: Deletes the app's settings on this computer (on a Mac also removes DiBeKho from Applications). You will be asked whether to delete the data folder too.
settings.uninstall_done_mac: Settings removed. Now drag DiBeKho from Applications to the Trash.
settings.uninstall_done_win: Settings removed. Now uninstall DiBeKho in Windows Settings → Apps.
stock.empty_hint: No products yet. Load the catalog from the monthly stock Excel sheet, then click 'Rescan notes'. New products on delivery notes can also be created in 'To do'.
catalog.pick_file: Choose the catalog Excel file (monthly stock sheet)
catalog.title: Import catalog — {file}
catalog.hint: Check each row. Double-click a cell to edit name, packing, variant, unit, category or stock. Untick rows you don't want. Products that already exist (same name, packing, variant) are not created again; tick such a row to update only its stock.
catalog.done:
{created} products added ({skipped} already existed).
Now click 'Rescan notes' to match delivery notes with the catalog.
catalog.not_sheet:
This file is not a catalog / monthly stock sheet (needs columns 'Tên sản phẩm' and 'Phân loại').
{error}
pending.skip: ✕ Not goods (shipping, service fee…) – drop line
pending.confirm_apply:
About to apply:
• Match {mapped} lines to existing products
• Create {created} new products
• Drop {skipped} non-goods lines
• Leave {later} lines for later

Notes are recorded with the lines you approved; 'Later' lines wait here and are added to the same order once decided. Wrong choice? Fix it under Settings → Products → 'Learned names on notes'.

Continue?
doc.reread_tip: Read this note file again with the current catalog and learned names
doc.confirm_reread:
Read this note again?

The current document is marked 'Replaced' and its stock is reversed; the app reads the file again with the current catalog and learned names. History is kept.

Want to pick another product for a line? Use Settings → Products → 'Learned names on notes' → 'Forget and read again'.
doc.reread_pending: The note is waiting for your choice under Needs attention.
settings.learned_hint: Choices you made under Needs attention. Wrong choice? Select the row and press 'Forget and read again': the app forgets it, reads again the notes containing that line, and they come back to Needs attention.
settings.confirm_forget:
Forget the choice for:
“{name}”

The app will read again {docs} notes containing this line. They will appear under Needs attention for you to choose again (old history is kept).

Continue?
settings.forgotten: Forgotten. {docs} notes are waiting for your choice under Needs attention.
settings.uninstall_done_mac_auto: Done. DiBeKho will remove itself ({path}) as soon as you click OK.
master.title: Master data (Excel)
master.hint: Export the product catalog and the customer list to one Excel file to read, check, or load on another computer. Importing it there gives exactly the same products (same codes) and customers. The file holds no stock or orders: to move everything, use 'Export data' above.
master.not_master: Not a DiBeKho master data file (it needs the 'Products' and 'Customers' sheets exported by the app).
master.confirm_import:
The file has {products} products and {customers} customers.

Products with the same code and customers with the same phone number are updated from the file; new products keep the file's code. The current data is backed up first.

Continue?
master.imported:
Master data imported:
• Products: {products_new} new, {products_updated} updated
• Customers: {customers_new} new, {customers_updated} updated
master.skipped: Skipped (already on this computer under another code):
master.note: Exported from DiBeKho at {at}. You may edit it and load it again with 'Import master data' (Settings → Data transfer and backups). Keep the column order.
inbox.catalog_detail: Monthly stock sheet: {count} products. Click 'Import catalog from Excel…' to preview and import.
inbox.confirm_hide:
Hide '{name}' from the list?

The file stays in the input folder; the app just stops reminding you (unless the file changes).
receipts.pick_file_tip: Pick a goods-in file or a catalog sheet from anywhere, including input/da-xu-ly
settings.confirm_delete_product:
Delete product {name}?

No document uses it. Delivery-note names learned for it are forgotten too (they will be asked again under To do).
settings.delete_used:
{name} is in {docs} documents and cannot be deleted: that would break the history and the stock.

Mark it “inactive” instead? It disappears from Stock, Stock count, Goods in and the product pickers; old documents stay as they are.
settings.delete_used_inactive: {name} is in {docs} documents and cannot be deleted (that would break the history and the stock). It is already inactive.
reset.title: Reset data
reset.hint: Use this to start over. The app always makes a backup first (restore it in the Data transfer and backups tab). Your files (delivery notes, input, output, backups) are not deleted; notes in phieu-giao-hang/da-xu-ly are moved back to phieu-giao-hang to be read again.
reset.confirm_stock:
Reset stock?

• Kept: the product catalog, learned names on notes, dropped lines.
• Deleted: every delivery note, goods-in, stock count and customer → stock back to 0.
• Notes in phieu-giao-hang/da-xu-ly are moved back to phieu-giao-hang and read again from scratch.

The app makes a backup first.
reset.confirm_all:
Delete all data?

The app goes back to a fresh install: no products, notes, customers or stock. Only the settings are kept (language, size, working folder).

The app makes a backup first.
reset.confirm_all_again: Are you sure? Press Yes to delete all data.
reset.done_stock: Stock reset. {files} note files were moved back to phieu-giao-hang to be read again. Notes with unknown product names are listed under To do.
reset.done_all: All data deleted. {files} note files were moved back to phieu-giao-hang. Load the product catalog again, then review the notes under To do.

Applies to ticked rows, existing products included. An empty stock cell leaves that product's stock unchanged. Double-click a cell to change the number.
catalog.stock_done: Stock of {count} products recorded from the file (date {date}).
catalog.pick_stock_hint:
No “remaining stock” column was found in {file}.
Choose the column that holds each product's stock (it is read on the same row as the product), or import the catalog only.
